label: AI narration (MBT)
note: Per-chapter MBT narration served from Cloudflare R2 at <base>/<prefix>/<bookId>-<chapter>.mp3 (e.g. https://audio.usmcmin.org/bible/8-1.mp3 = Ruth 1). Produced locally with Piper via bin/generate-mbt-audio.js from the clean MBT in docs/assets/mbt/mbt-bible.json, then uploaded to R2. The BTE reader probes each URL and only shows the chapter-page player once the file is live. This "books" map lists only books that have clean MBT text; books still being authored are omitted.
